grades.quote: sleep() releases the condition lock so that the code calling wakeup() can proceed. sleep() also context-switches to the scheduler in order to let other threads run while it is waiting. The implementation performs these two steps in a way that is atomic (indivisible) with respect to wakeup(), to prevent lost wake-ups.
grades.reason: Directly explains that lock release and the transition to waiting are atomic with respect to wakeup, preventing lost wakeups.
Only poses exercises; it does not explain how sleep releases the lock without losing a wakeup.
